queries_run: Twilio market share CPaaS gaining OR losing 2026
Twilio competitor threat new entrant AI voice agents displace CPaaS 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 自述：競爭者為 CPaaS、區域電信網路商、CRM/CX 廠商、獨立 CDP 與其他軟體公司；預期新進入者與新產品使競爭加劇。
findings.excerpt: With the introduction of new products and services and new market entrants, we expect competition to intensify in the future.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：市場高度分散、部分領域進入門檻相對低，競爭對手可能以較低價格或 AI 更快整合搶客，迫使降價。
findings.excerpt: Our competitors or other third parties may incorporate AI into their products, offerings, and solutions more quickly or more successfully than us, which could impair our ability to compete effectively and adversely affect our results of operations.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到獨立量化的 2026 份額消長資料；第三方稱 AI 語音新創（Bland、Vapi、Retell）搶語音支出，但為廠商/聚合站未驗證說法。Gartner 2026 CPaaS MQ（2026-05）Twilio 為 Leader、新增三家廠商，見 clues。

clues.claim: Gartner 2026 CPaaS Magic Quadrant：Twilio 與 Infobip 為領導者，Vonage 回到頂層，新增三家廠商入列。
clues.source: CX Today: Gartner Magic Quadrant for CPaaS 2026

clues.claim: 第三方分析稱 Bland AI、Vapi、Retell 等 AI 語音新創正從 Twilio 搶語音支出，但未在 CPaaS 份額追蹤中明顯可見。
